_meta.naming_note: Renamed 2026-07-10 (migration d5f7a9c1e3b5) — the table name IS the Amazon report type. The old name `rpt_afn_inventory_by_country` still resolves as a read-only compat VIEW; prefer `rpt_get_afn_inventory_data_by_country` in new queries.
_meta.description: Country-level FBA inventory for NARF-enrolled sellers. One row per (sku, country) showing quantity available for local fulfillment in that country. Pairs with rpt_get_afn_inventory_data: that table holds the pan-NA pool total; this one holds the per-country split.
_meta.retention_note: rows older than 7 days are pruned nightly (newest snapshot per store never pruned where applicable); query beyond the window returns a report_date_note

columns.note: The row's marketplace as the payload ships it (Amazon's ISO spelling — 'GB' where SellerSheet says UK). Auto-filtered from the store suffix; do not filter manually.
Internal tenant scope — auto-applied from `store`; never filter on it manually.
JSON of Amazon columns with no dedicated DB column (unmapped/new headers land here).
